The Story

During a two-month Facility Management internship at Cyient Ltd., Noida, I went beyond routine operations — spotting concerns, visualizing fixes, getting approvals and supporting implementation. From Excel automation to drainage and kitchen layouts, the through-line stayed the same: observe closely, propose practically, and see it through.
